title: Test the commit-failure rollback of name_engram_source_root, and move ScriptedEngramControlTransport to a test-support module
outcome: Follow-ups from the tm-5gi4 phase 2 round-5 review (Claude notes). (1) name_engram_source_root restores the entries, the generation counter, the pending line and the turn root (with its sealed revision) when commit_locked fails, but no test covers that path. Add one that injects a persistence failure; the stepped persist writer in src/tests/acceptance_evaluation.rs shows how. (2) ScriptedEngramControlTransport and its held-claims scripting (script_held_claims, replace_held_claims) live in engram_host_adapter.rs under cfg(test), which is already far over the Rust size threshold. Move them to a test-support module, as a pure move.
